name: 投掷
description: 角色挥臂投掷（砸缸掷石类），持物臂挥起、身体侧转蓄力

generation.promptTemplate: {characterAnchor}, throwing a stone with full arm swing, body twisted sideways, one arm raised high back ready to throw, {propAnchor} clearly in the raised hand, dynamic action pose, feet planted wide apart
generation.negativeExtra: standing still, arms down, relaxed idle pose, stone on ground, stone floating

acceptance: 持物臂明显挥起（非垂放）
身体有侧转蓄力感（非正面静站）
目标物（缸/窗等）在投掷方向上
